maddeler.e:
اشمؤززت (form IVq)
# اُشْمُؤْزِزْتُ (ušmuʔziztu) /uʃ.muʔ.ziz.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# اُشْمُؤْزِزْتَ (ušmuʔzizta) /uʃ.muʔ.ziz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# اُشْمُؤْزِزْتِ (ušmuʔzizti) /uʃ.muʔ.ziz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
